title: An App Designer page save moves PDM by 1 (PSVERSION and PSLOCK) and SYS by 1; PSPNLDEFN.VERSION is the new PDM
statement: Saving a page in Application Designer bumps PSVERSION and PSLOCK OBJECTTYPENAME PDM by one and PSVERSION SYS by one, and stamps PSPNLDEFN.VERSION with the new PDM value. Observed for create, add, move, resize, label, group box, delete and property saves; a save that adds several record-bound controls moved PDM by more (06-types, unexplained) and is not covered.
